fusions.name: Through the Gaps
fusions.desc: Drives a needle through the gaps in the target's armour, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Scale-Sewn Hem
fusions.desc: Whirls a hem sewn with steel scales, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Layered Quilting
fusions.desc: Raises a quilted barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and raises your armour by 10% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Arming Doublet
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a layer builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per layer (42% at full). Unfed, a layer fades every 10 seconds.
